subject.title: [Feature]: REST endpoint for session management in HTTP API integrations

question: Should OpenClaw expose mutating `/v1/sessions/*` HTTP session controls for trusted HTTP integrations, and which operations and operator scopes should be allowed?
rationale: Automation can prove the API gap, but it cannot decide the permanent security boundary for HTTP reset, compaction, model, and reasoning mutations.

options.title: Approve narrow admin-scoped REST controls
options.body: Add focused authenticated endpoints that map to existing session handlers, require appropriate operator scopes, and include route/auth/docs coverage.

options.title: Ship reset/status first
options.body: Limit the first REST surface to the common reset and read-only status needs while deferring model, reasoning, and compaction until the security model is clearer.

options.title: Decline mutating REST controls
options.body: Keep WebSocket/RPC and plugin APIs as the supported control planes and document that HTTP Chat Completions remains chat-only.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow admin-scoped REST controls
recommendation.body: Add focused authenticated endpoints that map to existing session handlers, require appropriate operator scopes, and include route/auth/docs coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed the open product/security follow-up in the issue discussion, while the Gateway implementation owners can support the technical design.
